claim_summary: For every finite simple graph, finite field, and tuple length, an explicit support and projective-coloring product gives all simultaneous common-centralizer codimensions; the maximum rises from n-c(G) for one element to n-i(G) for any two or more.
limitations: The formula is an exponential-sized support sum and is not a graph-isomorphism completeness result. Equivalent historical simultaneous-centralizer descriptions could exist. Independent mathematical auditing has not occurred.
scientific_integrity: Algebraic proof and separately implemented finite-field checks are supplied. Prior single-element formulas are explicitly credited; unproved bibliographic uniqueness is not asserted.
title: Joint centralizer rank spectra of graphical Lie algebras
